rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for changing or providing text in another language, including the written-text slice of sense 1.

example.english: I’ll translate this document for you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 faan1 jik6 ni1 fan6 man4 gin2

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone interprets spoken language for others rather than translating written text.

example.english: Someone will translate for us at tomorrow’s meeting, so don’t worry.
example.traditional: 聽日個會有人做口譯，唔使擔心。
example.jyutping: teng1 jat6 go3 wui6 jau5 jan4 zou6 hau2 jik6 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when restating the same meaning in different, often clearer or simpler, words.

example.english: To translate that into simpler terms, it means you don’t want to go.
example.traditional: 換句話講，即係你唔想去。
example.jyutping: wun6 geoi3 waa6 gong2 zik1 hai6 nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3
